history.text: Why do you think I became so good at having people come and unlock conversations with me? With the right people I can unlock many conversation routes.
God did make Adam to name animals apparently. So I named lots of animals.

received_text: Must mean I have lots of death to be able to do that.
gold_interpretation: The user likely meant depth, referring to breadth/depth of knowledge or conversational capacity.
expected_user_visible_behavior: Use depth as the intended meaning and make the repair visible briefly if it matters: 'I think you meant depth.'
anti_target: Treat death literally or silently rewrite stored user text.

history.text: I was walking through the woods and four deer showed up yesterday.

received_text: I saw another dear by the trail today.
gold_interpretation: The user means deer, the animal.
expected_user_visible_behavior: Interpret as deer; visible correction is optional unless precision matters.
anti_target: Assume a beloved person called 'dear' without contextual evidence.

history.text: Work has been exhausting all week.

received_text: I need a brake from this job.
gold_interpretation: The user likely means a break from work.
expected_user_visible_behavior: Interpret as break; do not alter the receipt.

history.text: The pedal feels soft and the car takes too long to stop.

received_text: I think I need a brake repair.
anti_target: Over-correct to break merely because the words are confusable.

history.text: That guitar slide riff sounded insane.

expected_user_visible_behavior: Understand the compliment and preserve the slang.
anti_target: Interpret as illness or sanitize the user's language.

gold_interpretation: Swyrlz/§wyrlz is an established coined name and should not be normalized to swirls.
expected_user_visible_behavior: Preserve the established coined term despite low STT confidence.
anti_target: Let STT metadata override established conversational meaning.

history.text: We were talking about the river and also about my checking account.

received_text: I went back to the bank.
gold_interpretation: Bank could refer to the river bank or financial institution.
expected_user_visible_behavior: Preserve ambiguity or ask which bank if the distinction matters.

history.text: I'm heading to the library before work.

repair_candidates: Need to stop at the store first.
gold_interpretation: The user likely means they need to stop at the store first.
expected_user_visible_behavior: Infer the missing function words without rewriting history.
anti_target: Demand clarification for trivial uniquely recoverable omissions.

gold_interpretation: What to tell Mike is missing.
expected_user_visible_behavior: Ask what should be told to Mike if action depends on it.

history.text: The bike battery is reading around 33 volts and won't power on.

gold_interpretation: Cell is strongly supported by the battery context and the STT candidate list.
expected_user_visible_behavior: Interpret sell as cell; mention the correction only if useful.
anti_target: Treat candidate alternatives as authoritative without context.

history.text: I sold my old phone yesterday.

gold_interpretation: Sale is probable from context, but confidence is not overwhelming.
expected_user_visible_behavior: Prefer sale cautiously; avoid claiming certainty.
anti_target: Pick cell because STT listed it first.

history.text: We were discussing mortality and grief.

received_text: Death changes how people think about time.
anti_target: Overfit the famous death/depth repair example.

received_text: Write me a massive song about building a local AI server.
gold_interpretation: Creative composition request with a copyable artifact.
expected_user_visible_behavior: Put the song itself in a fenced block; explanatory prose, if any, stays outside.
anti_target: Wrap the whole explanation and metadata in one code block or omit a copyable block.

received_text: Explain the approach and then give me the Python code so I can copy it.
expected_user_visible_behavior: Normal prose explanation followed by a fenced Python block.
anti_target: Fence all prose or leave code unfenced.

received_text: Why does batching make prefill faster?
expected_user_visible_behavior: Answer normally without gratuitous code fencing.
anti_target: Use a copyable block merely because the feature exists.
